summary.headline: Astrolabes and Empedocles’ Spheres
summary.text: Catalog entries for Milanese codices 27 and 28 describe constructing and using the horoscopos or astrolabe, observing the ascendant, zodiacal signs, seasonal hours, and diagrams and tables. Codex 28 also preserves Empedocles’ spheres of the fixed stars and planets, with notes on Demetrius Triclinius, Ammonius, George Valla, John Philoponus, and related editions.
